g.text: Drawing MFG-CUT-01 | Part CUT-01 — Cycloidal hook cutter disc | Qty 12
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: 6 mm AISI D2 tool steel (JIS SKD11 equivalent) | Process/finish: rough waterjet, vacuum harden/double temper 58-60 HRC, finish
Overall: X 57.620 × Y 6.000 × Z 56.692 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: OD 58.0; root circle R18.0 with smooth DXF transition; bore 25.01 +0.01/0; matched keyway width 6.005-6.010; final profile ±0.10 and
taper <=0.05 through thickness after CAM kerf compensation; t6.00 ±0.03; flatness/parallelism 0.03; tooth side deburr C0.15 max; axial working
gap 0.25-0.50 mm by metal shim; selected 5.995-6.000 key plus engraved index line registers stack; replace on crack, chip >0.5 mm, edge recession
GD&T/datums: A=shaft bore axis; B=ground stack face; C=keyway centre plane; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; inspect flatness/parallelism and stack gap with metal
shims; hardness and post-treatment grinding report required
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Artifact check: PASS only; fabrication HOLD pending full v0.8 gates. Physical NOT_RUN; machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
